claims.claim: Date-only starts map to same-day midnight; ends and instants map to following-day midnight.
endDate must imply a strictly later point than startDate.
Fact period form must match the declared periodType.
Missing timezone does not identify UTC or the machine's zone.
A same-date start/end denotes one calendar day under the selected rule.
Lexical 24:00:00 and canonical hour range differ; no general lexical ban follows.
